reason: Describes concrete rules-based breakout from consolidation zones around 50-day MA on daily timeframe for swing trades in US stocks.

universe.description: US stocks mainly technology sector; also E-mini futures

setup.rule: Identify rectangular consolidation zone (box) of 1 month or longer around flat 50-day MA
setup.quote: a month-long consolidation, which is one of the requirements for time... 50 MA box, which is a box that's surrounded by the 50-day moving average

setup.rule: Use TTM squeeze red for 3-4 week contraction confirming box
setup.quote: When you have these contractions take place, the TTM squeeze changes colors... Red being the most aggressive contraction... 30 days of a squeeze in price, you have a red squeeze indicator

entry.rule: Enter long on breakout above the box consolidation in direction of rising 50MA
entry.quote: it looks to enter at the break of that consolidation period. And it looks to participate in the trend... price will most likely move up out of it and continue higher

stop.rule: Stop below the box low or lower zone (e.g. 3920 in example)
stop.quote: it broke below it around 3920... you get short on a break of 3920... understanding of where our stops should be

exits.rule: Exit at next higher zone or target resistance
exits.quote: exit at the next zone above it... move from 4,100... to 4,300

sizing.rule: Risk ~5% per trade on all-in A+ setups; can size up to all-in when conditions met
sizing.quote: risk per trade is close to 4%... all-in trades set out to risk about 5% of his account value

market_filter.rule: Above key zone (e.g. 3900) participate in uptrends only; below stay cash or short
market_filter.quote: if the market gets above 3,900, I want to participate in uptrends. If the market gets below 3,900, I want to participate in downtrends or just stay in cash

ambiguities.issue: Exact momentum_lookback_days, consolidation_max_range_pct, trail_ma not specified numerically
ambiguities.assumption: Use 20-30 trading days for month-long box and 50MA as trend filter per quotes

ambiguities.issue: Short-side rules mentioned but engine is long-only
ambiguities.assumption: Focus only on long breakout rules
